name: PasswordInput
summary: Password entry with Show / Hide toggle in the trailing slot. Reuses the field shell; value renders mono with wider tracking so masking dots read as discrete.

keyboard: Tab again — focus the reveal toggle
Space / Enter on toggle — flip Show / Hide
Standard text-input keys for the value
rules: Reveal toggle MUST set aria-pressed and a descriptive aria-label ('Show password' / 'Hide password').
Default autoComplete='current-password' for sign-in, 'new-password' for sign-up / change.
Never disable browser autofill or paste.
If Caps Lock is detected (event.getModifierState('CapsLock')), surface a live-region warning beneath the field.
Always paired with a visible label via Field, or with aria-label.

do: Set autoComplete correctly per context (current-password vs new-password).
Honor browser autofill — the field shell defeats Chrome's yellow flash via the global recipe.
Pair sign-up fields with PasswordStrength (v0.8) for the segmented meter beneath the field.
Detect Caps Lock and surface a polite warning.
dont: Don't disable paste — users paste from password managers; blocking it is an anti-pattern.
Don't auto-clear on validation error — preserve the value so the user can correct.
Don't show the password by default — start masked, let the user opt in via the reveal toggle.

changelog.note: Initial release. Promotes the v0.6 audit-dashboard primitive in inputs.tsx to a dedicated contract. Reveal toggle in trailing slot; mono value with wider tracking. PasswordStrength deferred to v0.8.
